title: Dialysis
summary: At Rotary Samarpan Dialysis and Thalassemia Centre we carried out 1348 dialysis for 123 patients in this month.
description:
At Rotary Samarpan Dialysis and Thalassemia Centre we carried out 1348
dialysis for 123 patients in this month.
The underprivileged patient pays a nominal amount of Rs 300/- the rest is borne by club. Some dialysis are paid fully by the patient.
